_about: Scam warning signs for the Analyze message check (analyze.html#message), matched in code by js/analyze/message-check.js, never by a model. Each pattern is a JavaScript regular expression (case-insensitive, Unicode) run on the normalised, lower-cased message; a sign matches when any pattern matches and no 'unless' pattern does. coveredBy (optional): ids of stronger signs that make this one redundant in the list. strength: 'strong' (a scam on its own) or 'warning' (real messages can do this too). says: one plain sentence (160 characters max). guidance: an official page on an allowed host (js/what-now.js GUIDANCE_HOSTS). The signs follow FTC and NCSC guidance on text and email scams; tests/message-check.test.mjs checks every pattern, link and length.

signs.says: An unpaid toll, fine or traffic ticket by text or email. This is one of the FTC's top text scams.

guidance.title: Got a text about unpaid tolls? It's probably a scam

signs.says: Says a parcel is held or couldn't be delivered. Fake delivery problems are the FTC's most-reported text scam.
patterns: \b(?:package|parcel|shipment|delivery|order)\b[^.!?\n]{0,60}\b(?:on hold|held|could ?n[o']t be delivered|cannot be delivered|undeliverable|delivery (?:attempt )?failed|unable to (?:be )?deliver(?:ed)?|returned to (?:the )?sender|suspended|incomplete address)

guidance.title: Think that text message is from USPS? It could be a scam

signs.says: Asks you to confirm your address or pay a small fee before a delivery. Real couriers don't ask for this by text.

guidance.title: Think that text message is from USPS? It could be a scam

signs.says: Says your account is locked or suspended and asks you to verify it. That's how fake login pages get passwords.

guidance.title: How to recognize and avoid phishing scams

signs.says: Says a password, card or subscription is expiring and asks you to act. Real services do this too, so go to their site yourself.

guidance.title: How to recognize and avoid phishing scams

signs.says: Asks if you made a purchase or payment. Banks do send these, and so do scammers. Check in your bank's own app; never call a number given in it.

guidance.title: Is that unexpected text a scam?

signs.says: A deadline plus a threat (a fee, suspension or legal action). Rushing you is a classic pressure trick.

guidance.title: How to recognize and avoid phishing scams

signs.says: Asks for payment by gift card, cryptocurrency or wire transfer. Only scammers insist on these.
patterns: \b(?:pay|paying|payment|send|buy|purchase|deposit|transfer|get)\b(?:[^.!?\n]|(?<=\d)\.(?=\d)){0,60}\b(?:gift ?cards?|itunes cards?|google play cards?|steam cards?|apple cards?|bitcoin|btc|crypto(?:currency)?|usdt|tether|ethereum|bitcoin atm|crypto atm|wire transfer|wire the|western union|moneygram)\b

\b(?:gift ?cards?|itunes cards?|google play cards?|steam cards?|apple cards?|bitcoin|btc|crypto(?:currency)?|usdt|tether|ethereum|bitcoin atm|crypto atm|wire transfer|wire the|western union|moneygram)\b(?:[^.!?\n]|(?<=\d)\.(?=\d)){0,60}\b(?:scratch|photo of|card numbers?|codes? on the back|the codes?|as payment|to pay)\b

\b(?:gift ?cards?|itunes cards?|google play cards?|steam cards?|apple cards?|bitcoin|btc|crypto(?:currency)?|usdt|tether|ethereum|bitcoin atm|crypto atm|wire transfer|wire the|western union|moneygram)\s+only\b

\b(?:only\s+accept|accept\s+only)\b(?:[^.!?\n]|(?<=\d)\.(?=\d)){0,30}\b(?:gift ?cards?|itunes cards?|google play cards?|steam cards?|apple cards?|bitcoin|btc|crypto(?:currency)?|usdt|tether|ethereum|bitcoin atm|crypto atm|wire transfer|wire the|western union|moneygram)\b

guidance.title: Avoiding and reporting gift card scams

signs.says: Mentions paying by gift card, crypto or wire. Scammers ask for these because the money can't be got back, though real messages can mention them too.
patterns: ^(?=[\s\S]*\b(?:gift ?cards?|itunes cards?|google play cards?|steam cards?|apple cards?|bitcoin|btc|crypto(?:currency)?|usdt|tether|ethereum|bitcoin atm|crypto atm|wire transfer|wire the|western union|moneygram)\b)(?=[\s\S]*\b(?:pay|paying|payment|send|buy|purchase|deposit|transfer|owe|owes)\b)

guidance.title: Avoiding and reporting gift card scams

signs.says: Asks you to pay or 'refund' someone with Zelle, Venmo, Cash App or PayPal. Money sent this way is hard to get back.

guidance.title: A way to spot scams: how someone asks you to pay

signs.says: Asks you to send or read out a verification code. That code lets someone into your account; no real company asks for it.

guidance.title: What's a verification code and why would someone ask me for it?

signs.says: Asks you to reply ("Y") and reopen the message to make the link work. This switches off your phone's protection against links from strangers.

guidance.title: How to recognize and report spam text messages

signs.says: Claims to be a government agency or the police and asks for money or threatens arrest. Real agencies don't demand payment by text, email or phone.
patterns: ^(?=[\s\S]*\b(?:irs|hmrc|social security(?: administration)?|ssa|dmv|department of motor vehicles|medicare|fbi|ftc|police|sheriff|marshal|court|customs|border patrol|immigration|tax office|revenue service|department of (?:revenue|transportation|justice))\b)(?=[\s\S]*(?:\b(?:you owe|you still owe|must pay|immediate payment|unpaid|outstanding|warrant|arrest(?:ed)?|suspend\w*|seiz\w+|frozen|legal action|penalt(?:y|ies))\b|\bpay\s+(?:\$\s?\d|now\b|immediately\b|today\b|this\b|the (?:fine|fee|balance|amount)\b|your (?:fine|balance|debt|taxes)\b)|\b(?:send|make|submit)\s+(?:a\s+|the\s+|your\s+)?payment\b|\bpayment (?:is )?(?:required|due|overdue)\b|\b(?:a|the|your)\s+fine\b|\$\s?\d[\d,.]*\s+fine\b))

signs.says: An unexpected job offer with high pay for little work. The FTC says these texts are almost always scams.

guidance.title: That job offer text is probably a scam

signs.says: A friendly "wrong number" opener from a stranger. These often turn into investment or romance scams. Don't reply.

guidance.title: Why it's not rude to ignore "hi, how are you?" texts from strangers

signs.says: Someone says they're a relative or friend on a new number. Call them on the number you already have before sending anything.
patterns: \b(?:this is my new number|(?:i )?(?:lost|broke|dropped|smashed) my phone|my (?:old )?phone (?:broke|is broken|got stolen|was stolen|died)|(?:new|temporary) (?:number|phone),? save (?:it|this))\b

signs.says: A prize, refund or reward you have to pay or give card details to claim. Real prizes and refunds don't cost money.
patterns: ^(?=[\s\S]*\b(?:you(?:'ve| have)? won|you(?:'ve| have) been (?:selected|chosen)|winner|prize|reward|lottery|sweepstakes|giveaway|refund|unclaimed|compensation|cashback)\b)(?=[\s\S]*\b(?:claim|collect|receive|redeem|release)\b)(?=[\s\S]*\b(?:fee|pay|small charge|processing|shipping cost|card details|bank details|card number|account number|tax(?:es)? (?:first|upfront))\b)
